description: The test modules behind trading-runtime skip guards, run by scripts/trading_runtime_suite.py in validate.yml's trading-runtime job on the runtime the lock pins. Any skip there fails unless it matches one exclusion below with exactly its count. tests/test_trading_runtime_suite.py fails when a tests/ module with a trading-runtime guard is missing from this list.

exclusions.why: Its guard (tests/test_ibkr_paper_orders.py, _nautilus_available) requires nautilus_trader 1.231.0; the runtime pins 2.0.0rc5. A known exclusion until trading-cc ports or retires the module.

exclusions.reason_contains: retained page cache not present on this host
exclusions.why: The tests replay retained pages from the host's private state directory (~/.local/state/native-agent-stack/sim-paper/pages), which no runner holds.
hftbacktest is a separate cross-check runtime (blueprints/us-equities/sim-crosscheck-hftbacktest/requirements.lock), not part of the trading runtime's lock.
DuckDB belongs to the research environment, not to the trading runtime's lock.
